note: Window 2011-11-06 to 2012-11-06. The CDX query returned 44 HTTP 200 captures, below the limit of 50. The domain also has 2010 and 2011 captures from before the window. The checked page is from the June 2012 primary period, and the same site continues through September 2012. The lead came from a web search summary, not a page I fetched. The Wayback check decides acceptance.

lead_sources: Domain guess from the 2012 site name, confirmed only by the Wayback check
page_evidence: Re-Elect Rusty Bailey for Mayor of Riverside - Rusty Bailey for Mayor
note: Window 2015-06-07 to 2016-06-07. The CDX query hit the limit of 50 captures, so the count is a lower bound. The earliest returned capture is 2016-03-14, and an earlier capture may exist. The site has endorsements and about pages. rustybailey.com was a parked 'coming soon' page in January 2016 and is not used.

Web searches, the Ballotpedia and city clerk candidate statement results, and a local blog post gave no website. Wayback CDX probes of pauldavisriverside.com, pauldavisformayor.com, paulforriverside.com, paul4riverside.com, paulforriversidemayor.com and davisformayor.com returned no capture in the window. davisformayor.com has 2006 captures only and belongs to another race. The Ballotpedia page did not load, so a listed site could be missed.

lead_sources: Domain guess from the candidate name; the clerk list gives only the email jessica@nv.media
note: Window 2023-03-05 to 2024-03-05. jessicaqattawi.com has no HTTP 200 capture in the window. Only 301 redirects exist on 2023-03-31 and 2024-03-26. The nearest 200 captures are 2022-02-03 before the window and 2025-08-01 after it. This looks like a personal site, and a 2025-2026 capture links a Ward 4 council campaign, not the mayoral race. I never read an archived page naming a mayoral campaign, so I do not accept it. Web searches found no 2024 mayoral campaign site, and the guessed domains qattawi2024.com, jessicaforriverside.com and jessicaformayor.com had no capture.
